title: Shopify Beauty Store Design: Skincare Store Walkthrough | Fuse Theme, Fluid Preset
description:
Premium Shopify Theme Fuse
Fluid

Part 5 of our Fuse walkthrough: Fluid, the beauty and skincare preset. A store that sells skincare the way it's really bought, by routine, by ingredient, by concern: Shop by Step, a gift-with-purchase banner with a live countdown, quick view with sizes and shades, ingredient tabs, a featured product with a limited-time price, a shoppable social feed, and a product page with skin type, INCI, size options, Notify me on sold-out options, specifications as scales and an FAQ with filters.
